question: Who is the author of the book "The Third Pillar: How Markets and the State Leave the Community Behind"?
solution:
The correct answer is** ​**__**Raghuram Rajan**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The author of the book "The Third Pillar: How Markets and the State Leave the Community Behind" is **Raghuram Rajan.**
 
• The “third pillar” of the name is the** community we live in.**
 
• Economists all too often understand their field as the connection between **markets and the state, and they leave squishy social issues for other people.**
 
• Raghuram Govindarajan is an Indian financial expert and the **Katherine Dusak Miller Distinguished Service Professor of Finance at the University of Chicago Booth School of Business.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02321e3ddc2a415be1e66a9550c36f7e663faf7978bb6480e8e14272334956e8.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amartya Kumar Sen** is an Indian economist and theorist, who since 1972 has taught and served in the United Kingdom and the United States. 
 
• **Kailash Satyarthi started** **Bachpan Bachao Andolan** (Save Childhood Movement) in 1980 as the first people's movement for social justice, equity, education, and peace for all children in India. 
 
• **Jairam Ramesh** is an Indian politician related to Indian National Congress.​
